description.en: The member ID. You must specify only one of the following parameters: UserId and MemberId.

description.zh:
用户UID。如何查看用户UID，请参见 [ListWorkspaceUsers](~~449133~~)。
UserId与MemberId必须指定一个，不能同时指定。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You can call [ListWorkspaceUsers](~~449133~~) to obtain the ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You must specify only one of the following parameters: UserId and MemberId.

description.zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~)。
description.en: The workspace ID. You can call [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~) to obtain the workspace ID.
